approaches.title: Single-pass tracking of extreme values
approaches.summary: Track the three largest and two smallest numbers in one pass, then compare the products of the only two candidate combinations. Revision 2 preserves this strategy while expressing the updates with branchless min/max operations.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Maintains the three largest and two smallest values using conditional updates, then returns the larger candidate product.
Replaces conditional updates with equivalent branchless min/max expressions while preserving the single-pass extreme-value strategy.
